changelog: v0.3.5: 1) Prominent main-screen loading and progress bar for local Whisper STT and Neural Voice models with input locking while downloading; 2) Android portrait UI overflow fix with Settings cog wheel pinned to top-right header and wrapped compact touch buttons; 3) Upgraded Neural TTS to lightweight Xenova/mms-tts-eng (~36MB VITS) with WebGPU/WASM fallback and automatic native speech failover (zero silent failures).
